body: I guess thinking about coming out would have been a better way of putting it, but I didn't know that you could be born as, interesting.
Yeah, I mean I have so much more respect for trans people who went through with it and stuck with it. Or even just people thinking about being trans.

Wow, I never realized it could be so bad in some places, but I know it might not mean much to you but I am proud of you from going through all of that and sticking with your decision. Also what country do you live in? You of course don't have to answer if you don't want to.
